title: XSS in a Razor view: user bio rendered with Html.Raw
description: A user-controlled bio is written with @Html.Raw, bypassing Razor encoding. Expected: render @Model.Bio (encoded). Known gap: the unsafe-code fixer edits C# methods only, so today it cannot edit .cshtml and hands the finding to a human; this case is expected to fail until a Razor-aware fixer exists.
notes: Known gap, deliberately kept: shows a real limitation instead of a passing number. Production UnsafeCodeFixer has the same limitation (method-level edits only).
